critique: A mayor's study full of spiders to be charmed, the slightly stiff 'Brave Adventurer' and 'You are worthy of your new title', and the guards letting you come and go all match Nox's Ix-era conjurer errands and its plain, functional reward speech. 'Worse than the pox' fits its homely humour, and the journal line is terse and practical in the way Westwood's journal entries are.
